acquisition method: From each full scan, the 20 most intensive ions were selected for low-energy collision induced dissociation (CID)
alkylation reagent: Then, 0.55 M iodoacetamide was added and the samples were incubated for another 30 min in the dark.
cleavage agent: Trypsin was diluted in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and was added 1:25 (v/v) to the samples.
collision energy: selected for low-energy collision induced dissociation (CID) with 35% collision energy
enrichment method: we established a new method based on laser microdissection combined with mass spectrometry for the isolation and analysis of neuromelanin granules.
fragmentation method: selected for low-energy collision induced dissociation (CID)
instrument: coupled to an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany).
ionization type: The LC system was directly coupled with a nano electrospray ionization source (Thermo Fisher Scientific) to the Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer.
labeling: which yielded a table of the spectral counts for every peptide that belonged to a certain protein in a sample.
reduction reagent: Briefly, 250 mM dithiothreitol was added and the samples were incubated for 30 min at 60 °C.
